headings.text:
STAGE 5h  |  VSG CONTROL + SWITCHING MOSFET INVERTER
40 V DC  /  50 Hz  /  Ts = 100 us  /  10 kHz PWM

LIVE SIGNALS  |  Double-click a Scope, then Run
PWM channel order: AH, AL, BH, BL, CH, CL
06  ELECTRICAL PLANT  |  Double-click to inspect MOSFETs
10  SAVED DATA  |  Workspace timeseries (separate from live Scopes)

STAGE 5h  |  GATE COMMANDS -> SIX MOSFETS -> LC FILTER -> RL LOAD
Logic gates include 520 ns turn-on delay; the driver is not an electrical Vgs model.
N_AC: shared floating filter/load star; no direct connection to DC minus.
